name: puck
pronunciation_note: Owner request 2026-11-04. Short u (German 'Puck' as in ice hockey, English 'puck'); the final k is unvoiced in both. 'Pakt'/'pack' have a different vowel: near-misses. Bare 'Puck' is one syllable, so the addressed head is the trigger and the bare head needs listening before binding.
